title: trailboss --json doctor
description: What's working and what isn't. Printed in full even when a check fails; the exit code is then 1.

check.description: What was checked: version, config, index, source:<agent>, herdr, herdr-mod, herdr-layout, herdr-keys, tmux, tuios, gh. More may be added.

detail.description: One line for people: what was found.

fix.description: The command or step that would fix it; null when there's nothing to fix. Doctor never runs it.

status.description: ok; warn (works, or fixes itself, but something's off); fail (broken: exit code 1); skip (not installed or not used).

ok.description: False when any check's status is fail.
